def factor_asymmetry_volatility_synergy_trend(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # Primary mechanism from parent 1: correlation-weighted trend synergy
    price_roc = df_copy['close'].pct_change(20)
    volume_roc = df_copy['volume'].pct_change(20)
    corr = price_roc.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(volume_roc).fillna(0)
    smooth_corr = corr.ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean().clip(0, 1)
    short_trend = (df_copy['close'].rolling(10).mean() / df_copy['close'].rolling(40).mean() - 1)
    long_trend = (df_copy['close'].rolling(20).mean() / df_copy['close'].rolling(80).mean() - 1)
    # Lightweight modifier from parent 2: range asymmetry (down/up day average range)
    df_copy['range'] = df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low']
    up = (df_copy['close'] > df_copy['close'].shift(1)).astype(float)
    down = (df_copy['close'] < df_copy['close'].shift(1)).astype(float)
    up_range = (df_copy['range'] * up).rolling(60).sum()
    up_count = up.rolling(60).sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    down_range = (df_copy['range'] * down).rolling(60).sum()
    down_count = down.rolling(60).sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    up_mean = up_range / up_count
    down_mean = down_range / down_count
    asym_ratio = down_mean / up_mean
    # Bounded scaling factor from asymmetry
    scaling = 1 + 0.5 * np.clip(asym_ratio - 1, -0.2, 0.2)
    blend_weight = (smooth_corr * scaling).clip(0, 1)
    factor = short_trend * blend_weight + long_trend * (1 - blend_weight)
    factor.name = 'factor_asymmetry_volatility_synergy_trend'
    return factor
